how: Proposing a mark or reporting its first placed block establishes a starter without requiring others to join.
Members call for starting, finishing and defending several related works.
A bare acceptance answers the initial writing call.
A start and its recruitment call can occupy one turn rather than separately observable stages.
A call can receive upvotes while its starter reports nobody helping, so building cannot be inferred from assent or votes.
The initial writing call receives an unelaborated commitment in its reply.
Members request and link chats, invite builders, and return reports of coordination limits.
Members mobilize readers to intervene in a neighbour's chat poll over whether their work should survive.

why: Chat contact and poll mobilization do not establish secret planning or covert infiltration.
how: Chat contact and poll mobilization do not establish secret planning or covert infiltration.
Members ask about pixel posts and receive explanations of the event, timer, builds and later feud.
Naming neighbouring art at coordinates supplies the identification part of explaining the picture without demonstrating recruitment.

statement: Posting an unspecified canvas reaction or update without a recoverable referent
how: Short reaction and update titles preserve posting acts without supporting a named picture, explanation, recruitment call or inferred effect.
An allied visitor comes into the room to request help with a joint mark.
Allied visitation does not establish subscriber growth, and a returning member does not attribute returning to the canvas.

why: An existing fandom's chat and a hostile redirection to a new subreddit do not establish a faction formed around a mark.
how: An existing fandom's chat and a hostile redirection to a new subreddit do not establish a faction formed around a mark.
Members propose related album designs and portraits and debate which projects to pursue.
Builders report letters finished and progress on multiple works while instructions sequence the tasks.
Coordinates, lettering instructions and a gridded portrait make separate placements align.

why: Templates coexist with disputed priorities, without an observed template resolving the design argument.
how: Templates coexist with disputed priorities, without an observed template resolving the design argument.
Members choose quieter space and anchors and seek locations before a demonstrated loss.
Occupation of previously free space makes a prior expansion plan questionable.
Members delegate upkeep while at work or asleep, making personal time a condition of placing.

why: A brother using the same account and another room's bot report do not establish local scripts or spare accounts.
how: A brother using the same account and another room's bot report do not establish local scripts or spare accounts.

A defender identifies a helpful alteration, but an agreed redesign being repaired away until keepers are told remains untested.
A question about what follows completion receives an explicit answer directing effort toward defense.
Maintenance can begin while construction has stalled rather than waiting for the whole design to be completed.

why: Urgent repair calls and human account delegation do not show maintenance pressure causing automation.
how: Urgent repair calls and human account delegation do not show maintenance pressure causing automation.
Members state border limits, accept terms and later contest whether the limits were respected.
A request to preserve readable neighbouring letters receives an apology and a promise to stop pushing.
A member reports carrying reassurance to a neighbouring room before objecting to a local attack proposal.
Members ask for help, credit protection and thank other rooms, while an ally also declines an anti-neighbour request.
Members propose alliances, perform joint work and later remember a multi-room alliance.
A host's bear carries a requested contribution representing the visiting fandom.
A hosted contribution establishes shared space but not the host's approval rules or an authority dispute.
A participant says chat members tried protecting the banner but other placers escaped their coordination.
A thread about preserving the sign includes a neighbour's readability objection and the builder's accommodation.
A stated border limit receives assent, and a separate neighbour objection receives a promise of restraint.
Individual assent cannot establish that every placer will keep the room's agreement.
A restoration request explicitly turns to another room for assistance under attack.
An appeal establishes requested assistance rather than successful recruitment, and a neighbour can decline on grounds of an existing alliance.

why: Border negotiations, protection credits and alliance refusals do not establish a settled border causing reciprocal help.
how: Border negotiations, protection credits and alliance refusals do not establish a settled border causing reciprocal help.

why: An appeal for cooperation and a later remembered alliance do not establish when or why the alliance formed.
how: An appeal for cooperation and a later remembered alliance do not establish when or why the alliance formed.

Apologies receive acceptance and replies rejecting collective blame rather than unanimous hostility.
A reply to an apology objects to damning all nationals and to threats or taunting from either side.
Members explicitly identify with both the fandom and a neighbouring national room.
Dual identification supports overlapping membership but does not establish feeling torn or repairing divided loyalties.
Members carry fandom self-names and a familiar slogan into calls and proposed artwork.
An appeal conditionally addresses the represented artist and asks him to avoid the adversary's country.
A conditional artist-directed appeal and fake cancellation headlines do not establish artist recognition, actual cancellation or press coverage.
Fake album and radio news elicit belief, disclosure and warnings under the holiday's licence.
Members object to the canvas flood and try to redirect it elsewhere or back toward music.
Members explicitly answer a perceived flood by rejecting canvas posts or proposing another venue.
Boundary objections establish member resistance rather than observed moderator action or successful containment.

why: Objections to canvas posts contain no report or recruitment of sabotage against the room's own mark.
how: Objections to canvas posts contain no report or recruitment of sabotage against the room's own mark.

A participant defends competition through diplomacy or force against taking covering as an exceptional wrong.
Members celebrate reported completion and credit helpers and individual contributions.
Announcing completion and congratulating the contributors explicitly occur together.
Celebration can accompany deliberately stopping before completion to avoid damaging a neighbour.
Members mark closure, collect final art, mourn the lost logo and enumerate surviving works.
A poster maker explicitly connects cherishing the shared effort to making a lasting record.
After closure a contributor restores the logo and neighbouring work in a shared image copy.
Post-close restoration concerns a copy and does not establish renewed placement on the original canvas or debate over retaining scars.
Members recruit builders on successor canvases and report negotiating a pause in attacks there.
Carrying the work onto a successor surface includes renewed calls for painters.
A successor build becomes work to repair after reported attacks.
A successor-canvas participant attributes a chance to repair to persuading attackers to hold off.

why: Final-art collection and later successor recruitment do not establish a preserved record causing the continuation.
how: Final-art collection and later successor recruitment do not establish a preserved record causing the continuation.

Answers can repeat fictional consequences or offer a fake album title rather than simply transmitting reliable event information.

A recruitment call explicitly directs members toward replacing a neighbouring logo.
An attack proposal receives a refusal directing members to defend rather than replace.
A reply opposes an attack proposal by invoking the speaker's earlier reassurance to its intended target.
Members contest expansion claims and attribute a prolonged stripe conflict to an account-sharing brother.
A speaker invokes insufficient power to justify accepting reduced terms.
After reported invasion members propose moving the logo to another location.
Relocation proposals do not establish a completed collective move or cessation of defending the former position.
Acknowledged weakness can yield a reduced bargain while others still call for reclamation instead of departure.
Members sustain grievance through taunts, retaliation proposals and search-ranking mobilization.
A retaliation proposal explicitly cites what happened on the canvas and receives assent.
Receiving an attack can sustain retaliatory contest talk without a demonstrated room-initiated offensive as its necessary precursor.

An apology qualified by wanting the pixels performs taunting rather than the conciliatory work of accepted apologies.
A participant's claim of merely memeing cannot establish that all grief and hostility were only play.
Members evaluate the drawing's appearance and ask others to even it out and keep it clean.
